description: A clock-locked stereo reverse effect: it captures the incoming audio in beat-long cells and plays them back backwards on demand

params.text: Latches the reverse on and off; a press takes effect at the next quarter-note boundary rather than at once, so a drum hit is never cut in half
Latches the freeze on and off, repeating one captured cell; it makes the reverse audible whether or not FLIP is latched
Sets the length of the frozen cell: a half, a quarter or an eighth of a beat. It does nothing while FRZ is off

inputs.text: One pulse per quarter note. Every capture and every switch in the module is aligned to these edges
A rising edge turns the reverse on for the rest of the beat, without latching
The right audio input; it follows the left input when unpatched
Holds the freeze on while the voltage here is 1V or above

outputs.text: The left output: the input while the reverse is off, the reversed capture while it is on
The right output: the input while the reverse is off, the reversed capture while it is on

notes: with nothing patched to CLK there are no beat boundaries, so no capture is ever completed and the audio passes through untouched
the crossfade between the dry input and the reversed capture takes 4ms, and the capture buffer holds 8 seconds
menu: 1 PPQN (Submit standard) — reads each pulse at CLK as one quarter note
4 PPQN (compatibility) — reads four pulses at CLK as one quarter note

high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
